descripcion: Water-soluble source of potassium and nitrate nitrogen, widely used in fertigation and foliar nutrition programs. Its high solubility and low salt index make it suitable for sensitive crops and precision irrigation systems. It is one of the most versatile bases for formulating complete nutrient solutions.
aplicaciones: Fertigation of vegetables and fruit crops
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid or prills, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble fertilizer that supplies calcium and rapidly assimilated nitrate nitrogen. It is associated with fruit firmness and the reduction of physiological disorders linked to calcium deficiency. A standard component of the calcium tank in fertigation and hydroponics.
aplicaciones: Fertigation of fruit and vegetable crops
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble source of phosphorus and ammoniacal nitrogen, used during the rooting and crop establishment stages. Its slightly acidic reaction in solution improves phosphorus availability in hard water. A frequent base in fertigation and starter programs.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nitrogen-free water-soluble fertilizer combining phosphorus and potassium, associated with the flowering, fruit set and fruit filling stages. Its low salt index makes it suitable for foliar applications and fertigation in sensitive crops. In the food industry it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Foliar fertilization during flowering and filling
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble source of magnesium and sulfur, key elements in the plant's synthesis of chlorophyll and proteins. It is used in fertigation, foliar applications and the correction of deficiencies in leached soils. Its versatility also gives it outlets in cosmetics and other industrial uses.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid, crystal size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nitrogen source in widespread use for soil fertilization and diluted foliar applications. It is one of the most widely used fertilizers in the world thanks to its cost-to-nitrogen ratio. It also has applications in animal nutrition and industry, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — prills or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Chloride-free source of potassium and sulfur, indicated for salinity-sensitive crops such as fruit trees, coffee and export vegetables. It is associated with improvements in fruit quality, size and postharvest life. Available in grades for soil application or for fertigation systems.
aplicaciones: Fertilization of fruit trees and coffee
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Iron micronutrient protected with an EDTA chelating agent, which keeps the element available to the plant in nutrient solutions and foliar applications. It is used to prevent and correct iron chlorosis under moderate pH conditions. Common in hydroponics and short-cycle fertigation.
aplicaciones: Fertigation in substrates and moderate-pH soils
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or microgranules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-stability iron chelate designed to keep iron available even in calcareous and alkaline soils where other chelates lose stability. It is a standard reference for correcting iron chlorosis in fruit trees, citrus and perennial crops via soil or fertigation.
funciones: Iron chlorosis corrector in alkaline soils
aplicaciones: Chlorosis correction in fruit trees and citrus
formas_referenciales: Solid — microgranules or soluble powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble source of zinc, a micronutrient associated with internode elongation, the development of new leaves and fruit formation. It is used in foliar applications, fertigation and micronutrient blends. It also has outlets in premixes for animal nutrition in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid or powder, depending on hydration, the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated source of boron, an essential micronutrient in flowering, pollen viability and fruit set. It is used in foliar applications and in fertigation, especially in high-demand crops such as avocado, palm and brassicas. Its handling requires careful dosing given the narrow margin between deficiency and excess.
aplicaciones: Foliar fertilization during flowering and fruit set
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble source of molybdenum, a key micronutrient in biological nitrogen fixation and in the activity of the nitrate reductase enzyme. It is used at low rates in legume seed treatments and in foliar blends. A common complement to inoculants in soybean, bean and forage crops.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Marine-origin biostimulant obtained from the brown seaweed Ascophyllum nodosum, associated with abiotic stress tolerance, rooting and fruit set. It provides natural compounds such as alginates, mannitol and hormone precursors. It is integrated into foliar and fertigation programs throughout the crop cycle.
formas_referenciales: Solid — soluble powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — concentrated extract, depending on the manufacturer's presentation

descripcion: Biostimulant based on free amino acids obtained through the hydrolysis of plant proteins, associated with crop recovery after stress from drought, cold or phytotoxicity. It facilitates nutrient assimilation and acts as a natural complexing agent in foliar blends. Compatible with most nutrition programs.
formas_referenciales: Solid — soluble powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — concentrated solution, depending on the manufacturer's presentation

descripcion: Potassium salts of humic acids derived from leonardite, used as a soil improver and fertilizer efficiency enhancer. It is associated with root development, moisture retention and the soil's cation exchange. It is applied through fertigation, drenching and soil treatments.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, granules or soluble powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Low-molecular-weight fraction of humic substances, with high solubility and the ability to complex nutrients to promote their foliar and root absorption. Compatible with foliar applications and low-pressure fertigation systems. It is used as a companion to micronutrients and soluble fertilizers.
formas_referenciales: Solid — soluble powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Modified trisiloxane-based surfactant that reduces the surface tension of the spray solution, promoting more uniform coverage of the leaf surface. It is associated with improved penetration through stomata and a reduction in water volume per hectare. It is dosed at low rates in the mixing tank.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — appearance and viscosity depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Potassium salts of vegetable-origin fatty acids, used as an adjuvant and leaf surface cleaning agent in integrated management programs. It helps remove sooty mold, honeydew and residues that interfere with photosynthesis. It is an input associated with ecologically oriented production schemes.
aplicaciones: Foliar washing of sooty mold and honeydew
Integrated management and organic farming programs
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid or paste, depending on concentration, the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Highly refined paraffinic oil used as an adjuvant in agricultural sprays, where it improves the adhesion, distribution and persistence of the spray solution on the treated surface. It is used in crop management programs for fruit trees, citrus and ornamentals. It requires proper emulsification in the mixing tank.
aplicaciones: Adjuvant in fruit trees and citrus
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic acid with dual use in agriculture: a phosphorus source in fertigation and a pH corrector for irrigation water with high alkalinity. It helps prevent dripper clogging caused by carbonate precipitates. In food and industry it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Acidulant in industry in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, concentration depending on the manufacturer's presentation

descripcion: Organic acid of biotechnological origin used in agriculture as a pH and hardness corrector for spray water, preventing the alkaline hydrolysis of inputs in the tank. Its chelating capacity helps keep the cations in the spray solution available. Broad cross-sector use in food, cleaning and cosmetics in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Acidulant in food and cleaning products in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid — anhydrous or monohydrate, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Vegetable-origin polymeric dispersant derived from lignin, used in the formulation of agricultural wettable powders and water-dispersible granules. It keeps particles in stable suspension in the spray tank and acts as a binder in granulation. It is also used in concrete, ceramics and other industrial processes.
aplicaciones: Formulation of wettable powders and water-dispersible granules
Industrial additive for concrete and ceramics
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, shade varies depending on the lignin source, the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mineral clay used in agriculture as an anti-stress protective film, associated with the reduction of sunburn and heat stress on fruit and leaves. It forms a physical particle barrier that reflects excess radiation. Its versatility also gives it outlets in cosmetics, ceramics and coatings.
aplicaciones: Filler in cosmetic and industrial formulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, shade and fineness vary depending on the deposit, the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated source of sulfur for crop nutrition and the amendment of alkaline or sodic soils, where its gradual oxidation contributes to lowering pH. It is used in soil correction programs and as a component of fertilizer blends. A cross-sector raw material with uses in industry as well.
aplicaciones: Correction of alkaline and sodic soils
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, granules or pastilles, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nitrogen fertilizer that simultaneously supplies sulfur, with an acidic reaction in the soil, useful in alkaline soils and sulfur-demanding crops. In tank mixes it is used as a hard water conditioner by sequestering antagonistic cations. A widely used input in extensive crops.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystals or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
